description.value: The Best Western Plus Barclay Hotel is Port Alberni's largest full-facility hotel, with 84 eco-friendly rooms and suites on Vancouver Island's west coast. The property includes an on-site Pastimes Sports Bar and Grill, a year-round spa and sauna, and a hotel liquor store, making it a self-contained stop after a long day in the saddle. Its central Port Alberni location puts guests within minutes of the Log Train Trail, Sproat Lake, and other Alberni Valley attractions.

address.value: 4277 Stamp Avenue, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 7X8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms this is a real, operating hotel at 4277 Stamp Avenue, Port Alberni. The website consistently uses the name 'Best Western Plus Barclay Hotel' rather than the OSM name 'Best Western Barclay Hotel' (missing 'Plus'), and the contact email on the website (frontdesk@bestwesternbarclay.com) differs from the OSM tag (info@bestwesternbarclay.com); both discrepancies are flagged. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, or e-bike charging appears anywhere on the website; complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed on multiple pages, and the on-site Pastimes Sports Bar and Grill confirms evening food availability.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Best Western Barclay Hotel' but the website consistently uses 'Best Western Plus Barclay Hotel' (missing 'Plus' designation in OSM).
Email mismatch: OSM tag lists info@bestwesternbarclay.com but the website contact page and footer show frontdesk@bestwesternbarclay.com.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel confirmed by live website with full amenity and contact details; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Pastimes Sports Bar and Grill; website also notes an on-site restaurant serving breakfast and dinner per guest reviews
